family_name: Autex Surface Finishes Frontier Raft beam

spec.description:
Autex Surface Finishes Frontier Raft - Beam (including Acoustic Timber Raft
Beam) is an innovative acoustic ceiling beam system that combines the warmth and
appearance of real timber or architectural stone with high-performance sound
absorption. Built from scored and folded 12mm Cube polyester felt digitally
printed with high-resolution woodgrains or stone textures using water-based
UV-cured ink, it is available in Beam 100 (87mm high) and Beam 250 (227mm high)
profiles. It delivers an NRC of 0.75 to 0.95 and Group 1 fire safety without the
weight, cost, or warping of solid timber beams.

install:
Plan
ceiling layout allowing recommended spacing (150mm centres for Beam 100; 300mm
centres for Beam 250)

Install Frontier mounting clips or suspension track
securely to structural ceiling

Slide RAFNEXRT aluminium extrusion into the
folded Beam raft top channel

Align Autex mounting clips with channel and
turn 45 degrees to temporarily position

Adjust along length, check grain
alignment, and twist clips 90 degrees to lock firmly in place

Fit black
extrusion end caps to beam ends for a clean architectural finish
selection_checklist:

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Surface Finishes Frontier Raft - Beam (including Acoustic
Timber Raft Beam) is an acoustic ceiling beam system that combines
high-definition digitally printed timber grains and stone textures with hollow
sound-absorbing profiles (Beam 100 at 87mm and Beam 250 at 227mm depth).
Constructed from 12mm Cube polyester felt with an internal air gap and aluminium
suspension track, it delivers superior sound absorption (NRC 0.75 to 0.95) while
eliminating the weight, warping, and fire hazards of real wood beams. Rated
Group 1 fire compliant under AS ISO 9705 and certified carbon neutral with
over 60% recycled PET, it provides a warm, lifelike timber ceiling feature for
commercial and educational spaces.
